versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Commute Carbon Counter.
- Log and track per-trip, per-week, and per-month CO2 emissions across 14 transport modes.
- Compare carbon footprint of different commute options, including per-passenger adjustments for carpools.
- Generate reports, view emissions breakdowns, and see top contributors to your footprint.
- Project annual emissions trajectory against a personal budget, with visual savings vs a solo-car baseline.
- Export logs and emission data for personal or team use.
